items.headline: Six police DIGs transferred
items.summary: IGP Priyantha Weerasooriya transferred six Deputy Inspectors General with immediate effect, covering Kalutara, Kegalle and Jaffna as well as the CID, Police Welfare and Special Bureau posts. The moves still need National Police Commission approval.

items.headline: Doctors and workers' groups protest tomorrow
items.summary: The GMOA will step away from routine duties from noon to 2 p.m. on Monday (23 Nov) over Budget 2027; emergency services are exempt. The Workers' Struggle Centre also plans protests at workplaces on Monday, ahead of one- and two-day strikes from 30 Nov.

items.headline: Two sentenced to death over 2003 grenade attack
items.summary: The Avissawella High Court sentenced two men to death after a unanimous jury found them guilty over a 2003 grenade blast in Eheliyagoda that killed three people. The attack grew out of a clash between estate groups at a wedding.

items.headline: Motor Traffic Department website hit by cyber attack
items.summary: The Department of Motor Traffic's website was attacked overnight. The department says its Narahenpita office is not affected and services will run as normal on Monday.

items.headline: Minister compares presidential travel bills
items.summary: Minister Nalinda Jayatissa told Parliament that former President Ranil Wickremesinghe spent Rs. 1,010 million on 33 foreign trips in about 26 months. He said President Anura Kumara Dissanayake spent Rs. 31.7 million on eight trips over a similar period.

items.headline: Police to help keep drugs off university campuses
items.summary: Deputy Education Minister Dr. Madhura Seneviratne says a special programme with the police is being drawn up to stop outsiders bringing drugs into universities.

items.headline: Divulapitiya e-waste plant's licence suspended
items.summary: The environmental licence of an e-waste facility in Divulapitiya was suspended after a 16 Nov fire there. Environment Minister Dhammika Patabendi called it a precaution against pollution.

items.headline: Jaffna University opens inquiry into student clash
items.summary: The university has started an internal probe into a 19 Nov hostel clash between management students that injured three. The 21 students arrested by Kopay Police are remanded until 26 Nov.

items.headline: Three remanded over fake Litro cylinder racket
items.summary: Kotadeniyawa police arrested three people, including a father and son, accused of repainting yellow gas cylinders to pass them off as Litro cylinders. They are remanded until 20 Dec.

items.headline: Arrest over Borella crossing assault
items.summary: A 37-year-old man was arrested over an assault near the Borella Cemetery roundabout that began with an argument over a horn at a pedestrian crossing.

items.headline: Heavy rain of about 75mm expected today
items.summary: Parts of the Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces and the Galle and Matara districts may get about 75mm of rain. Showers are expected elsewhere, with several spells in the North and East.

items.headline: Russian tourists rescued at Hikkaduwa
items.summary: Police lifesavers rescued two Russian tourists who were swept out by strong currents at Hikkaduwa beach and gave them first aid.

items.headline: COP31 draft seeks to save climate talks
items.summary: A new draft at the COP31 summit in Antalya drops any explicit call to phase out fossil fuels but recalls the earlier pledge. It also admits for the first time that the world is on track to miss the 1.5C goal.
